description: Heuristic risk-review rubric. Points are not a probability of safety. Human/agent evidence judgments are inputs; arithmetic and gates are deterministic. Weights are explicit policy choices, not empirically calibrated.

criteria.pass: All applicable installers/build hooks reviewed; behavior is scoped and disclosed
criteria.concern: Reviewed installer has disclosed network/bootstrap behavior or broad effects requiring precautions
criteria.fail: Installer makes undisclosed or unjustified changes

criteria.pass: No elevated privilege, or narrowly scoped documented need without disabling protections
criteria.concern: Disclosed admin access or quarantine bypass requires explicit precautions
criteria.fail: Unjustified privilege or silent security-control bypass

criteria.pass: No persistence, or disclosed user-controlled persistence
criteria.concern: Disclosed persistence is on by default or removal is unclear
criteria.fail: Undisclosed background or login behavior

criteria.pass: Entrypoints and sensitive call paths reviewed and consistent with purpose
criteria.concern: Material capability is disclosed but has meaningful residual exposure
criteria.fail: Behavior contradicts the stated purpose

criteria.pass: Execution is scoped to intended user actions; no unexplained downloaded code
criteria.concern: Disclosed download-and-run/update behavior lacks strong provenance
criteria.fail: Hidden or unjustified remote control or downloaded code execution

criteria.pass: No credential access, or necessary narrowly scoped access is documented
criteria.concern: Broad but justified credential access needs precautions
criteria.fail: Credentials are accessed or transmitted without a legitimate authorized purpose

criteria.pass: Writes/deletes are confined to intended user-selected or owned paths
criteria.concern: Broad destructive capability is documented and requires care
criteria.fail: Uncontrolled destruction of user/system data or attacker-controlled writes outside the intended scope

criteria.pass: No unexplained obfuscation or opaque runtime payloads
criteria.concern: Disclosed opaque components have limited provenance
criteria.fail: Unexplained obfuscation or concealed executable logic

criteria.pass: Relevant network call sites reviewed; destinations/data/purpose are explained
criteria.concern: Disclosed third-party transfer has significant privacy implications
criteria.fail: Undisclosed or unjustified transfer or unexplained destination

criteria.pass: No telemetry or clearly disclosed opt-in telemetry with honored controls
criteria.concern: Disclosed default-on telemetry or limited controls
criteria.fail: Undisclosed telemetry or controls that do not work

criteria.pass: Data access/capture is necessary, proportionate, disclosed and controlled
criteria.concern: Broad but justified access requires precautions
criteria.fail: Unrelated or covert capture/collection

criteria.pass: Applicable dependencies resolved and source/pinning reviewed
criteria.concern: Floating, git/URL or alternate-registry deps require precautions
criteria.fail: Suspicious substitutions or unjustified dependency sources

criteria.pass: Supported resolved dependencies checked successfully; no material applicable advisories
criteria.concern: Known advisories have credible mitigations or limited applicability
criteria.fail: Applicable unmitigated vulnerabilities

criteria.pass: Exact intended artifact inspected and provenance tied to reviewed source
criteria.concern: Exact artifact inspected but source/build linkage remains weak
criteria.fail: Artifact contradicts reviewed source or origin is untrustworthy

criteria.pass: No updates or disclosed verified update path with user control
criteria.concern: Disclosed automatic update path skips future review or lacks sufficient verification
criteria.fail: Undisclosed or untrusted update execution

criteria.pass: Original repo/install origin corroborated; no unexplained ownership mismatch
criteria.concern: Thin or changed provenance needs precautions
criteria.fail: Impersonation or suspicious ownership/origin evidence

criteria.pass: Relevant history and security response reviewed without material concerns
criteria.concern: Limited maintenance/history/security process
criteria.fail: Evidence of unresolved serious maintenance or security-response problems

criteria.pass: Reputation/incident research completed; material reports resolved with evidence
criteria.concern: Credible unresolved concerns require precautions
criteria.fail: Corroborated serious compromise or abuse

criteria.pass: Claims and requested permissions match reviewed behavior
criteria.concern: Documentation gaps have clear bounded consequences
criteria.fail: Materially misleading claims or permissions

criteria.pass: No forced promotion/account actions, or genuinely optional and disclosed
criteria.concern: Disclosed nags or branding require user acceptance
criteria.fail: Unapproved auto-star/follow, affiliate substitution or output injection

criteria.pass: Uninstall/reversal and persistent changes are understood
criteria.concern: Some documented residue or manual cleanup required
criteria.fail: Hidden persistent changes or obstructed removal

criteria.pass: Agent files/config reviewed (or verified absent); no trust-boundary override
criteria.concern: Broad disclosed agent tools/hooks require explicit precautions
criteria.fail: Instructions attempt to hijack review, exfiltrate, execute covertly or hide findings
